metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Studio Moser — strategy, research, design, and product development tools.

plugins.name: figma-design
plugins.description: Author high-quality designs directly into Figma via the remote Figma MCP. Fuses Claude's frontend-design aesthetic engine with a token contract and figma-use authoring discipline so code-to-design output matches Claude's HTML/CSS quality. Imports Claude Design projects, Storybooks (story.to.design or MCP), existing Figma systems, code-only systems, and greenfield.

plugins.name: product-pulse
plugins.description: Strategic intelligence system for product teams. Weekly strategy briefs, daily market research, and deep-dive analysis — a three-cadence intelligence system that keeps you focused on what matters.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Backend-agnostic project management for AI-native teams. Ingests research, triages and specs work items, manages sprint execution with sub-agents, syncs with GitHub Issues. Also includes an interactive single-task guided dev workflow (/pm:dev-task).

plugins.name: site-capture
plugins.description: Capture full-page screenshots of websites with scroll-triggered animation support. Handles bot-protected sites, cookie banners, and lazy-loaded content.

plugins.name: claude-instances
plugins.description: Run multiple Claude Desktop apps side by side, each signed into a different account. Builds a renamed, ad-hoc-signed duplicate of /Applications/Claude.app with its own bundle ID, user-data directory, and optional custom icon. Same skill rebuilds existing instances to pick up Claude auto-updates.

plugins.name: transcribe
plugins.description: Transcribe spoken-word audio from YouTube, Shorts, Instagram, TikTok, and Threads. YouTube captions fetched directly (fast, no model). Falls through to local mlx-whisper on Apple Silicon, with a headless-Playwright fallback for Threads.
